verdict.rationale: Warp says it ships an API, CLI, SDK and MCP as a platform. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.warp.dev/openapi.json, and the docs describe API keys for headless authentication in CI, containers and servers. Agents can also be started from scripts and CI via the Oz CLI or through custom webhook triggers. Missing for 10: details in the pack on which endpoints and operations the API covers (the API reference excerpts mostly cover the CLI), and independent or hands-on proof of driving Warp through the API.
